title: UK-based Creator Fund closes a $56M fund to back European PhD founders, reaching them in universities before they're pulled into academia, Big Tech, or US labs (Mike Butcher/Pathfounders)
summary: Mike Butcher / Pathfounders: UK-based Creator Fund closes a $56M fund to back European PhD founders, reaching them in universities before they're pulled into academia, Big Tech, or US labs — Creator Fund has closed a $56 million European fund to back PhD founders before they have a pitch deck, let alone a company.
